d:
The Thunder defeated the Suns, 125-114 tonight in Oklahoma City. Ajay Mitchell contributed a team-high 30 points to go with 5 assists and 2 rebounds, with Shai Gilgeous-Alexander of the Thunder adding an additional 26 points (11-18 FG, 1-5 3P). Jalen Green finished with a team-high 20 points along with 4 rebounds for the Suns in the losing effort. The Thunder improve their record to 4-0 with the win, while the Suns fall to 1-2 for the season.
